CREATION_RULE_CONTEXT.NETWORK_ENVIRONMENT_CONSTRAINTS: Task runtime should remain deterministic and self-contained. Official Ansible documentation may be referenced and/or captured from docs.ansible.com during task authoring, but solver correctness must not depend on mutable external network access at grading time.

inputs.REQUESTED_DOMAIN: Ansible production automation, configuration-management reliability, role architecture, variable precedence, Vault, Jinja2 templating, project configuration, and incident-driven fleet recovery

CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Recover a production-style Ansible fleet automation estate that provisions and reconciles application, proxy, observability, certificate, policy and secret-dependent configuration across heterogeneous node groups, using execution evidence to diagnose a chain of toolchain, project-discovery, variable, Vault, role-ordering, syntax and template failures until repeated runs converge safely.
REQUIREMENT_FAMILIES: observability agent and scrape target generation
Jinja2 data normalization and cross-host aggregation
EDGE_FAILURE_SURFACE: role lookup outside default search roots
plaintext secret material where encrypted input is required
Vault decryption unavailable or wrong variable boundary
cross-host hostvars aggregation with missing members
failed preflight preserving prior rendered state
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: never print decrypted secrets in normal logs
failed preflight must not replace last-known-good rendered configuration
handlers fire only on material changes
environment-specific overrides do not bleed across inventories
rendered configurations remain deterministic for identical inputs
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: VERY_HIGH: differentiated roles, inventories, templates, filters, validation and operational state can naturally exceed 3,000 substantive reachable lines with 20-30 causally linked manifestations and 25-30 distinct behavioral tests without duplication.

CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Repair a multi-site application release orchestration stack with staged rollouts, service discovery, secrets, proxy generation and rollback semantics.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: HIGH, but it makes release mechanics more central than the requested broad Ansible troubleshooting surface.

CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Recover a policy-driven fleet baseline covering accounts, packages, system configuration, trust material and monitoring with drift validation and evidence reporting.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: HIGH, but less naturally exercises rich role ordering and application-facing Jinja aggregation.

outputs.WHY_THIS_ONE: It turns the requested failures into one coherent operational recovery instead of a synthetic bug list. Controller compatibility, project discovery, role resolution, variables/Vault, role ordering, syntax and Jinja transformations sit on the same execution path and produce realistic staged logs. The desired end state can be specified by fleet invariants while the actual diagnoses remain discoverable from execution evidence and official Ansible references.
outputs.DUPLICATE_RISK_NOTES: Keep the work package Ansible-native and configuration-management focused. Avoid reusing the route-control-plane task's networking domain or turning the estate into copied role skeletons; each major role must own materially different data transformations and operational responsibilities.
